Landing.faqA1: Yes — completely free, with no ads and no subscription. It is our ministry to make God's Word accessible to everyone.
Landing.faqA2: The Judson Burmese Bible, the King James Version (English) and the Mizo Go Bible. More translations for Myanmar's languages are on the way.
Landing.faqA3: The mobile app stores the entire Bible on your device, so you can read without an internet connection. The website needs a connection.
Landing.faqQ4: I use the old Myanmar Bible app. What happens to my data?
Landing.faqA4: Version 3.0 updates the old app in place. Your bookmarks, notes and highlights are carried over automatically.
Landing.faqA5: Ask any question about the Bible in Burmese or English and get answers grounded in scripture, with references you can open and read.
Landing.finalCtaDescription: Open the Bible in your browser right now, or take it with you on your phone.

Legal.pIntro: Myanmar Bible (the mobile app and this website) is a free ministry service. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.
Legal.pCollectBody: When you create an account we store your email address and the name and profile picture you provide (or that Google/Apple shares when you sign in with them). If you continue as a guest, we create an anonymous account with no personal information. Your bookmarks, notes, highlights, pins, reading position and verse reports are stored so they can be synced to your account.
Legal.pUseBody: We use your information only to run the service: signing you in, syncing your data across devices, fixing reported verse problems, and improving the app. We do not sell your data, and we do not show ads.
Legal.pAiBody: Questions you type into the AI chat and verse finder are sent to an AI service to generate an answer. Please do not include personal information in your questions.
Legal.pStorageBody: Your data is stored with our hosting provider (Supabase) and is encrypted in transit. The mobile app also keeps a copy of the Bible and your markers on your device so it works offline.
Legal.pDeleteBody: You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Delete Account in the app. This permanently removes your personal information and synced data. You can also contact us to ask about your data.
Legal.pChildrenBody: The service is suitable for general audiences and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
Legal.pChangesBody: If this policy changes we will post the new version here and update the date above.
Legal.tIntro: Thank you for using Myanmar Bible. By using the app or website you agree to these terms.
Legal.tServiceBody: Myanmar Bible is provided free of charge as a ministry, with no ads and no subscriptions. Bible texts come from their respective translations; we strive for accuracy and welcome verse reports from readers.
Legal.tContentBody: Notes, bookmarks and highlights you create belong to you. Verse reports you submit may be used to correct the Bible text for everyone.
Legal.tUseBody: Do not misuse the service — for example by attempting to disrupt it, abusing the AI features, or submitting unlawful content.
Legal.tWarrantyBody: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. AI-generated answers may contain mistakes — always check them against the Bible text itself.
Legal.tLiabilityBody: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any damages arising from your use of the service.
Legal.tTerminationBody: You may stop using the service and delete your account at any time. We may suspend accounts that abuse the service.
Legal.tChangesBody: We may update these terms; continued use after an update means you accept the new terms.
